card.intuition: As a session grows, each token's attention budget is spread across more competitors, shrinking the signal on any meaningful relationship. Same model, same parameters — just more context to attend over. It presents as the model getting worse mid-session: constraints start slipping, it re-asks things it was told, and it writes code that ignores a file it read earlier.
card.analogy: A developer with a fixed daily energy budget who keeps stacking tasks into the same workday. The first hours are sharp; by hour six they forget the constraint from the morning briefing despite being the same person. More coffee (re-pasting) helps briefly; the real fix is resetting — clear the board, or start a fresh cycle.
card.time_complexity: O(C squared) per request because attention pairs all tokens in the window — degradation is not free: a bigger context costs more per request while attending worse.
card.space_complexity: Context/memory footprint: finite per-token attention is spread across a growing window, so long contexts bury earlier content; recovery comes from removing context, not adding it.
when_to_use: Declining instruction-following mid-session: treat it as a signal about context length, not about the model
Recovery by removing context: clear and reload only what the task needs, or compact
Handing off to a fresh session when the window is crowded instead of pushing through
Explaining the smart zone / dumb zone effect: faithfulness hallucinations rise as signal on dismissed relationships shrinks
gotchas: It is gradual — no error and no threshold, so by the time the slips are obvious you are already deep in the dumb zone
Re-pasting the ignored instruction adds another competitor to the same crowded window and helps only briefly
The fix and the cause point the same direction: remove context, do not add more

steps.label: Turns accumulate
steps.annotation: Every turn adds tokens to the window, and each token's attention budget is spread across more competitors.

steps.label: Signal shrinks
steps.annotation: The pairing between a call site and the definition it read earlier loses influence as noise crowds in.

steps.label: Same model, worse output
steps.annotation: Only the context length changed; the model and its parameters are identical.

steps.label: Gradual slide
steps.annotation: Each turn is only slightly worse than the last, which is why the decline is hard to catch from inside the session.

steps.label: Re-paste fails
steps.annotation: Re-adding the ignored instruction just adds a contender to the same crowded window and buys only brief relief.

steps.label: Remove context
steps.annotation: Recovery comes from removing context: clear and reload only what the task needs, compact, or hand off to a fresh session.

exercise.prompt: Model attention degradation: the fixed attention budget must be split among a growing number of competing tokens.
hints: The signal splits evenly across the original plus each new competitor.
Add the competitor count to the baseline of 1 in the denominator.
